g.text: A bipolar square wave contains odd harmonics with decreasing amplitudes

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Unit-amplitude, zero-mean, 50% duty bipolar square wave. The positive-frequency panel reports sinusoidal peak amplitudes, not two-sided Fourier
coefficients. Even harmonics and DC vanish. Truncated sums exhibit Gibbs overshoot near discontinuities.
